slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: The report names Comoros only in its annex of composite score bands from the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round: digitization under 35%, civil registration process under 35%, infrastructure and resources 35-49%, planning and coordination under 35%, legal framework 65-79%, overall 35-49%. The digitization band is a composite of several questions and does not say how Comorian offices record events, so no fact is taken; the parent may want the band as context.
